name: Ultrasonic out of Bounds
hint: An ultrasonic distance comparison outside 3–400 cm is outside the sensor's measurable range, so obstacle decisions may be impossible or unreliable.
instruction: Accept ultrasonic distances only from 3 cm through 400 cm and validate thresholds before comparing them.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@mBot ultrasonic sensor [port3 v] distance \(cm\) :: sensing) > (500)> then
say [Invalid distance]
end
